# Durlabh Daryani — AI Product Manager

> Portfolio of Durlabh Daryani, an AI Product Manager based in Jaipur, India. Showcases shipped AI-first products, case studies, product-thinking essays, frameworks, and an AI lab.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero, about, featured products, case studies, experience, frameworks, AI lab, education, and contact.
- [Projects](/projects): Full index of shipped products, prototypes, and case studies.
- [Product Thinking](/thinking): Essays on product management, AI product development, discovery, growth, and analytics.
- [Thoughts](/thoughts): Archive of LinkedIn posts and short-form product thinking.

## Essays

- [How I build MVPs in 6 weeks](/thinking/mvp-in-6-weeks): A repeatable 6-week loop for going from problem to validated product.
- [AI Product Development in 2025](/thinking/ai-product-development-2025): Evals, prompts-as-spec, and human-in-the-loop.
- [Customer discovery without a research team](/thinking/customer-discovery-solo): Solo PM discovery playbook.
- [Choosing a North Star metric](/thinking/north-star-metric): Leading indicators of retained value.
- [Prompt engineering as product design](/thinking/prompts-as-product-design): Treating the system prompt as UX.
- [Retention loops that actually compound](/thinking/retention-loops): Designing self-reinforcing product loops.
- [Windsurf vs Cursor: an AI PM's take](/thinking/windsurf-vs-cursor): Comparing the two leading AI-native IDEs for product teams.
